messages:
alex: Quick company-wide heads-up — on Mon 2026-04-06 we’re rolling out two billing changes that affect free-tier customers and overage handling. Short summary below.

maria: TL;DR?

alex: 1) Introduce a short-lived sustained-rate cap (SRC): free-tier projects will have a soft sustained token rate (tokens/min) to prevent accidental runaway costs. 2) Redistribute unused promotional credits: unused monthly promo credits will be rebalanced to end-of-month grace buckets for eligible accounts.

devon: How "soft" is the SRC? immediate hard block or throttling?

alex: SRC is soft: it applies adaptive throttling and a short burst buffer. If a project exceeds SRC for >60s, requests are rate-limited with 429 and a Retry-After. We’ll surface metrics in the Console and send a one-time email alert at the second violation.

jen: Any change to invoice line items or metering?

alex: No change to metering units or pricing; invoice format unchanged. The only invoice-visible change is a new line item "SRC throttle credits" when we automatically apply grace credits to cover throttle duration. Finance and support decided this is clearer than obfuscating in refunds.

maria: Which customers get redistributed promo credits? everyone on free-tier or only certain promos?
alex: Eligible accounts = accounts with active promotional credits issued by Redwood (startup credits, onboarding promos) that remain unused by the last day of the billing month. Credits issued via partner resellers are excluded. Full policy will be in the billing docs.

billing-bot: Automated note: rollout window 2026-04-06 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-07 04:00 UTC. Feature flags: src-enforcement, promo-redistribution. See /deploys/1955-SRC-rollout.

devon: Ops ask: if SRC trips for Dedicated customers, do we auto-fallback to Dedicated pool or is it per-project?
alex: SRC only applies to free-tier and pay-as-you-go hosted projects. Dedicated and Private deployments are exempt. For hybrid routing we’ll prefer the pinned deployment; no auto-migration.

jen: Support playbook?

maria: Drafted playbook: short message + link to Console usage tab, instructions to request temporary burst uplift, sample cURL to check current sustained rate:

jen: can you paste the cURL?
maria: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/sustained_rate?project_id=proj_123
```

maria: Support triage steps: 1) confirm SRC violation in Console 2) check if promo-redistribution applied 3) offer 1h temporary uplift if on trial 4) escalate to billing if invoice-impacting.

alex: Messaging: we’ll send a short customer email and Console banner on rollout day. Internal comms: product + support + sales will get a pre-rollout FAQ tomorrow 09:00 PDT.

devon: Post-rollout monitoring? thresholds?
alex: Ops dashboard will track: SRC hits/min, customers throttled, promo-redistribution events, and support tickets opened. Pager threshold: >200 unique accounts throttled in 10m -> ops page.

jen: Anything customers need to do now?
alex: Recommend: check your project usage patterns and set per-project rate limits if needed. If you have active promo credits you want to preserve, contact sales before month-end.

maria: +1. I'll circulate the FAQ and support snippets after the 09:00 sync. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all — ping me with anything critical before EOD.
